items.title: Eaton (ETN) Wins Falcon 10X Role On A Fair Value Debate
items.summary: Dassault Aviation’s decision to use Eaton (ETN) hydraulic power and fuel system technologies on its new Falcon 10X business jet gives investors a fresh data point on the group’s aerospace exposure. For Eaton, that Dassault win lands at a tricky moment for the share price. The stock has fallen about 14% over the past month and 21% across 90 days, yet still carries a positive year to date share price return of roughly 3% and a 5 year total shareholder return above 100%.
